en: A colorized aerial-view postcard showing a large red-brick military barracks complex set in a green valley and surrounded by forests and fields. Multiple long rectangular buildings and courtyards form a regimented layout, identified in German text at the top as barracks for the 5th Field Artillery Regiment in Pirna on the Elbe River. The style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
